'''Thal-Ka Cloister''' was a cloister area located in the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thal-Ka Cloister appears as an area on Voss in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion.
